name: Koide Ritsu
source:
A member of the basketball team, [url=/c568]Amane[/url] and [url=/c580]Kazuki’s[/url] senpai. She always says that she doesn’t climb up the head of director [url=/c588]Sakashita[/url], and is always following her orders. Though her parents are doctors, she doesn’t know anything about medical treatment.

[From Shiori-chan's review]
